journal_lines: §aBlue dust in the cracks first. §oThen the smell of deep stone and something older.§o §lLapis§l behind the grey.
§aBright blue in the wall, unexpected as sky underground. Took the whole seam.
§aPowder came off blue when I struck it. §lLapis§l runs wide here. Good find.
§aDeep blue vein, rich and consistent. Three strikes and the wall opened up.
§aStained the paw working it out. §oBlue like the outside of a held breath.§o Lapis, heavy and fine.
§aA nodule pressed into the deepslate like something deliberate. §lLapis§l, dense and clean.
§aBlue dust settled on the fur and stayed there. Carried the smell of it home too.
§aThe seam ran into the ceiling. Took what was in reach. Left the ceiling.
§aRich pigment in the stone. §oSomething like the colour of deep water, but solid.§o Lapis. Worth it.
§aFound the vein by the colour change — grey stone, then suddenly blue. Followed it.
§aChipped carefully. §lLapis§l crumbles if you're rough with it.
§aWide seam, easy access, consistent colour all the way through.
